description: Phase H — Durable Functions activity. Receives { Portal, Tier, StreamName, StreamPath } from orchestrator; performs auth + single-stream poll + ingest; returns @{ StreamName, RowsIngested, LatencyMs, Success, Error }. Per directive 16. Activities CAN do non-deterministic work (KV reads, portal API calls, current time). Binding name 'ActivityInput' MUST match run.ps1 param name and MUST NOT be 'Input' (PowerShell automatic-variable shadow).
